Formal subject it · 要点精讲(第2轮): it acts as formal subject, replacing the real subject (infinitive or clause) placed later.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:It is + adjective/noun + to do / that clause。
It is important to learn English.|It takes time to master a skill.|It is said that... reportedly|It is + adjective + for sb to do|It is kind of sb to do (evaluating a person's character uses of)
It is important to keep a diary in English.
It is important to keeping a diary in English.|It is important keep a diary in English.|It is important keeping a diary in English.|It is important to keep a diary in English.
column4: It is + adjective/noun + to do / that clause。正确句:It is important to keep a diary in English.
